posts.name: evandan457
posts.cooked:
I’m so, so sorry to make yet another reference, but…

Corpses drained of all life force? Looks like one of the villains is going to be Shang Tsung from Mortal Kombat.

Now that I’m done with that…

Whoever he is, maybe those syringes are what gives him his powers. Think of Bradley Cooper in Limitless. Or maybe those are what he uses to drain people’s “life force”, which he then heals himself with. Maybe he’s dying and those are the only things keeping him alive. He’s not a villain, he’s just misunderstood!

But I don’t think he’s going to be Dawn’s nemesis. Through some serious investigation and really specific deduction, my friend and I have determined that he’s a villain. Mainly we looked at Adam’s list of hypothetical voice actors, crossed out the female slots, crossed out Plague Rat, crossed out the villain duo, leaving us with only two slots: one hero and one villain. Finally, we just said “He’s holding a dead body. He looks mean. He’s a villain.” So yeah, detective skills all over the place right there. He’s another villain.

And you know that villain duo we just mentioned? I said this in some other thread (and so did a few others), that Tachyon’s flipped side has an ice man and a tornado woman in the background. On Adam’s voice actor list, there was a man and a woman in the same villain slot. So, ladies and gentlemen, we can expect to see Tachyon’s nemeses in Rook City.

If I get all of these right, you all owe me $5.

But Chris just informed me I got something wrong… He didn’t say what, but… You guys get to keep your money. :’(
